definitions.explanation: the act of cutting something out, or the resulting cut-out piece; commonly refers to coupons, sections of forms, or digital editing functions

examples.japanese: {切|き}り{取|と}り⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please cut along the cutting line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{取|と}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貼|は}った→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I pasted the newspaper clipping into my notebook.

examples.japanese: ⟦テキスト→テキスト：01469_tekisuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{取|と}り⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{貼|は}り{付|つ}け→貼り付け：05224_haritsuke⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧な⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧です。
examples.english: Cut and paste of text is a basic operation.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{取|と}り{線|せん} - line to cut or tear along (on forms, coupons)
- {切|き}り{取|と}り{式|しき} - tear-off (coupons, forms)
- {切|き}り{取|と}り⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{貼|は}り{付|つ}け→貼り付け：05224_haritsuke⟧ - cut and paste
- ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{取|と}り - image cropping

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{貼|は}り{付|つ}け→貼り付け：05224_haritsuke⟧ - paste
- トリミング - trimming/cropping (photos)

ETYMOLOGY:
The noun form of ⟦{切|き}り{取|と}る→切り取る：04238_kiritoru⟧ (to cut out).
